create_smollm3_config: create a SmolLM3Config with custom vocab size, hidden size, and number of hidden layers
build_smollm3_model: build a SmolLM3Model from a SmolLM3Config for causal language modeling
create_smollm3_causal_lm: create a SmolLM3ForCausalLM model initialized from SmolLM3Config for text generation
create_smollm3_attention: create a SmolLM3Attention module with optional RoPE and sliding window attention per layer
create_smollm3_decoder_layer: create a SmolLM3DecoderLayer that inherits from LlamaDecoderLayer for transformer blocks
